messages:
Leah Park: Quick: spun up a 'mini warm' for Apex trial to reduce cold starts and capture early churn signals. Short ops checklist below.
Omar Rizvi: Paste the checklist please.
Leah Park: 1) Prefill: 3 jobs across 24h, ~3k tokens total. 2) Cache: convo_prefix_ttl=2h (trial=20m). 3) Batch: batch_max_tokens=64, max_batch_size=6. 4) Streaming: enabled for UI, client timeout=250ms fallback to non-stream. 5) Telemetry: emit cs.probe event with prompt_family, tokens_prefilled, fallback_flag.
Gia Tran: For renewal risk: if usage falls >50% week-over-week for 2 weeks, auto-create ticket and AE ping.
Omar Rizvi: Also add prefill:planned tag to job metadata so SRE ignores spike alerts.
CS-Reminder: REMINDER: create CS-7450 for Apex renewal follow-up if health flags.
Leah Park: Action items: Omar -> tag + job metadata; Gia -> automation rule; I will draft 1-page handoff. Meeting in 20m.
